segments.text: You may be asking yourself,

segments.text: on using methylene chloride in my laboratory?

segments.zh: 答案是，长期

segments.text: or repeated high exposure levels to methylene chloride
segments.zh: 或反复高水平接触二氯甲烷，

segments.zh: 会对心脏、肝脏和大脑

segments.text: on the heart, liver, and brain,

segments.zh: 正是由于这些暴露影响的性质，
